fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant the event occurred, normalized from whatever raw format the source used.
fields.justification: Every downstream stage (timeline, detection, triage) has to sort and correlate events across sources on one common clock.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Name of the host that generated or observed the event.
fields.justification: Almost every investigation scopes to a specific host, but auditd records never carry one in the raw line, so this cannot be mandatory without quarantining all Linux audit telemetry.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: The origin format of the record, one of windows_json, linux_text, network_csv, network_json.
fields.justification: Lets a rule or analyst filter to a technology family without knowing every raw file name behind it.

source_mapping.windows_json: assigned during intake (Task 0 classification), not read from the record
source_mapping.linux_text: assigned during intake (Task 0 classification), not read from the record
source_mapping.network_csv: assigned during intake (Task 0 classification), not read from the record
source_mapping.network_json: assigned during intake (Task 0 classification), not read from the record

fields.name: source_origin
fields.description: Whether the record came from the real evidence pack or from Module 2 student-generated telemetry.
fields.justification: 3x03 triage must be able to exclude or separately weight self-generated test telemetry from genuine evidence.

source_mapping.network_csv: constant: evidence_pack (no student network telemetry exists)
source_mapping.network_json: constant: evidence_pack (no student network telemetry exists)

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level category of the event such as authentication, process, file, network, or audit.
fields.justification: Needed by 3x02 detection rules and 3x03 triage filters to group events independently of source vendor.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized severity level (info, low, medium, high, critical) assigned to the event.
fields.justification: Gives 3x03 triage a single sortable field to prioritize the queue instead of re-deriving urgency from raw source fields every time.

fields.name: user
fields.description: Username associated with the event, when the source identifies one.
fields.justification: Attributing an action to an account is a core question in almost every investigation, and not every event has one.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Name of the process or program that generated the event.
fields.justification: Process-level detection (living-off-the-land binaries, unexpected parent/child pairs) depends on having this as its own field, not embedded in raw_message.

source_mapping.windows_json: provider, or event_data.Image for Sysmon records

fields.name: pid
fields.description: Process ID associated with the event, when the source records one.
fields.justification: Correlating multiple events to the same process instance (not just the same process name) is needed for process-tree analysis.

fields.name: command_line
fields.description: The full command or arguments executed, when captured.
fields.justification: The specific command run is frequently the single most decisive piece of evidence in a process-execution investigation.

source_mapping.linux_text: parsed_fields.message (e.g. sudo COMMAND=...) or student telemetry command field

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IP address of the event, for network-observable or remote-logon activity.
fields.justification: Network-origin questions (where did this come from) are answered per-flow or per-logon, so this has to exist independent of hostname.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IP address of the event, for network-observable activity.
fields.justification: Egress/lateral-movement detection needs the destination side of a flow as its own field, symmetric with src_ip.

fields.name: src_port
fields.description: Source port of the network flow, when applicable.
fields.justification: Port pairs distinguish concurrent flows between the same two hosts, which src_ip/dst_ip alone cannot do.

fields.name: dst_port
fields.description: Destination port of the network flow, when applicable.
fields.justification: The destination port is usually what identifies the service being accessed (22, 443, 445, etc.), a key triage signal.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Transport or application protocol of the network event (TCP, UDP, DNS, etc.).
fields.justification: Protocol-aware detection rules (e.g. DNS tunneling, unexpected protocol on a port) need this independent of the port number.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The outcome or disposition of the event, such as allow, block, success, or failure.
fields.justification: Separating what happened from whether it succeeded is required to tell a blocked attack apart from a successful one.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: The original, unmodified log line or message text the event was parsed from.
fields.justification: Normalization is always lossy in some direction, so analysts need a way back to the exact original evidence to verify any derived field.
